Whispermoon is the debut studio album by Listener.
It was released on Mush Records on July 29, 2003 .
It peaked at number 163 on the CMJ Radio 200 chart and at number 4 on CMJ's Hip-Hop chart .
Jason MacNeil of AllMusic gave the album 3 stars out of 5, saying, "Not as polished or glossy as bigger rap stars, this record has a certain independent aura around it .
" Rollie Pemberton of Pitchfork gave the album a 6.6 out of 10 and said, "The saving grace of Whispermoon is its varied production .

"
